listing.seoTitle: U-Maynooth, Moyglare Road , Maynooth, Co. Kildare

images.caption: Bespoke, high quality U fit-out included.
Black out blinds to all bedrooms.
Well laid out kitchen, ample storage.

prs.location:
U Maynooth is on the doorstep of Maynooth Town, a mere 5 minute walk to the town centre and its great selection of shopping options. The main street is lined with a growing selection of eateries and bars that have earned the prestigious Purple Flag recommendation, in recognition of the area’s vibrancy as a night-time location. The iconic four-star hotel, Carton House, (a 5 minute drive from U Maynooth) has two championship golf courses, while there are also GAA, soccer and rugby clubs in the area. There are four primary and three secondary schools in the town, plus of course the University. Transport links are also excellent; a fast and regular train service (only a short walk from the development) takes commuters straight into Dublin city centre, Connolly Station,  in only 45 minutes, while the N4 motorway ensures that motorists can access the M50 and the city centre quickly and conveniently.

*Our team will endeavour to respond to all enquiries. However, this may not be possible in all cases due to the high volume of interest for the property and we wish you all the best with your property search*

prs.location:
Stoneybatter Place is located in Dublin 7, a vibrant and well-connected area known for its independent cafés, restaurants, and cultural spots. TU Dublin Grangegorman is just a short walk away, while Trinity College is approximately 2km from the residence, making it easily accessible on foot, by bike, or via public transport.

The property is well served by multiple bus routes and the Luas Red Line, providing a quick and convenient commute into Dublin City Centre and across both the north and south of the city. There is also a direct bus route serving UCD, making it a practical option for students commuting to campus. Heuston Station is nearby, offering further connectivity.

listing.title: Balroy Hall, Carpenterstown Road, Castleknock, Co. Dublin
listing.seoTitle: Balroy Hall, Carpenterstown Road, Castleknock, Co. Dublin

prs.tagLine: Discover Luxury Living in the Heart of Castleknock
prs.location:
Prime Location 

Balroy Hall is situated in the vibrant community of Castleknock, offering a perfect blend of urban convenience and suburban tranquility. Discover the local attractions and amenities that make Castleknock a sought-after location: 

Local Places of Interest: 

Phoenix Park: One of Europe's largest enclosed parks, perfect for picnics, jogging, and outdoor activities. Home to the Dublin Zoo, Aras un Uachtarain and countless historical landlmarks. 

Farmleigh House: A stunning historic estate offering guided tours, beautiful gardens, art exhibitions and cultural events. 

Castleknock Golf Club: Enjoy a round of golf at this prestigious 18-hole course set in picturesque surroundings. Also close to Luttrellstown Castle Golf and Country Club. 

Nearby Amenities: 

Shopping and Dining: Explore an array of shops, cafes, and restaurants in Castleknock Village and nearby Blanchardstown Centre. 

Excellent Schools: A selection of top-rated primary and secondary schools within easy reach. 

Convenient Transportation: Excellent transport links including the Castleknock train station, multiple bus routes, and easy access to the M50 motorway. 

Healthcare: Nearby to healthcare facilities including Connolly Hospital Blanchardstown and various local clinics. 

Schools: Proximity to excellent educational institutions including Castleknock College, Mount Sackville Secondary School and several primary schools.
